metadata.description:
A certified canonical selected-modulus census of one-place differenced Stark packets over real quadratic fields for squarefree radicands 2 ≤ D ≤ 200 and finite-ideal norm at most 100. The corrected claim boundary distinguishes 3,936 empty-support rows (T), 1,560 quadratic-support rows (Q), and 2,704 higher-order rows (H). Every Q row has an exact packet-value-orbit polynomial. A proved deleted-prime cover theorem characterizes exactly when a quadratic packet is identically one. The H taxonomy has complete mechanism statuses on 2,699 rows and preserves five incomplete historical quartic constructions; 12 of 232 Engine-B member transports are proved. The package contains the DOI-bearing paper, TeX source, and deterministic replay companion.

Record DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21729947. Companion results paper: 10.5281/zenodo.21713178.
metadata.title: A Certified Canonical Census of One-Place Stark Invariants over Real Quadratic Fields: Exact Quadratic Value Orbits and the Higher-Order Frontier
